visualStyle.lighting: cold blue exteriors, warm claustrophobic interiors
visualStyle.color: ice blue vs. blood and fire

analysis.themes: An Antarctic crew meets a creature that imitates them perfectly — the monster is really paranoia itself, dissolving trust until the group destroys itself.
analysis.atmosphere: Freezing isolation and mounting suspicion; the empty widescreen frames make every character look alone even together.
analysis.narrative: A chamber piece of accusation and testing that escalates from unease to open warfare — who is human becomes unanswerable.
analysis.visual: Dean Cundey's widescreen photography uses negative space brilliantly; Bottin's practical effects remain the genre benchmark.
analysis.characters: MacReady leads not by heroism but by ruthlessness — survival demands becoming as suspicious as the enemy.
